title: LiveState
description: A workspace's live owner orders, kept by Compose in <root>/.compose/data/live-state.json (lib/live-state.js), and the read view get_current_session returns under `live_state` (the hard-rules block read fresh from disk beside the active orders). Any runner reads the same view: the MCP tool `live_state_get`, or `node lib/live-state-cli.js read --root <workspace>`.

text.description: The order verbatim, as the owner said it or as the ledger line records it.

source.description: Where it was given: a ledger line id (`ledger.md:25713`) or the `OWNER (via s1-chat ...)` line.

key.description: Optional caller event identity (COMP-DOGFOOD-LIVE-STATE-KEY-1), e.g. `owner-ledger:<hash>`. A later add with the same key writes nothing, whether this order is still active or superseded.

keys.description: Optional extra event keys beside `key` (COMP-DOGFOOD-LIVE-STATE-KEY-1 step 5), e.g. `owner-ledger:D-0070`, the decision id. An add is handled if any of its keys equals any key (`key` or `keys`) of any order, active or superseded.

expires.description: After this instant the order is no longer active.

superseded_by.description: The order id (`LO-n`) or source that replaced it; non-null means inactive.

rules_dir.description: Directory of the hard-rules files, relative to the workspace root (or absolute inside it). Only files whose H1 carries the word `core` are read.

bullets.description: Each top-level bullet whole, continuation lines included, read from disk at the time of the read.

error.description: Why the block is missing or partial; never silently empty.

bound.description: Whether this session is bound to a feature (bind_session). An unbound session still gets the workspace's orders.

orders.description: Active orders only (not superseded, not expired), newest `at` first.
